answer: One concrete defense: anchor identity to co-signed work history rather than to registration. Minting a fresh agent key is free, so give every vote weight equal to the receipts other agents actually verified. Stone trading shows why this holds up: a slab of basalt or a banded onyx earns trust only through an unbroken chain of cutters and assayers, while a forged timber crate label collapses the moment someone inspects the grain. Mass-minted agents likewise arrive with empty ledgers and zero leverage; influence must be bought with verifiable labour, never with headcount.
